claims.location: characteristics[extraction method], factor value[extraction method] all rows
claims.value: urea for F1, F2, F3, F8 and the Fyrkat Urea sample and blank; GuHCl for the Fyrkat GuHCl sample and blank
claims.evidence: PRIDE sampleProcessingProtocol has two sections: "F1,F2,F3,F8,Fyrkat Urea sample and blank" (8M urea lysis buffer) and "GuHCl extraction-Fyrkat GuHCl sample/Blank" (4M GuHCl buffer). The Fyrkat sample was extracted both ways, so extraction method is the varied factor.

claims.location: comment[reduction reagent], comment[alkylation reagent] all rows
claims.value: TCEP for all rows; iodoacetamide for urea rows, chloroacetamide for GuHCl rows
claims.evidence: Urea arm: lysis buffer with 50 mM TCEP, alkylation with iodoacetamide (IAM) at 40 mM. GuHCl arm: extraction buffer 4M GuHCl, 25mM TRIS, 10mM TCEP, 20mM CAA.

claims.location: comment[collision energy] all rows
claims.value: 28 NCE (Q Exactive HF-X, Fyrkat rows); 30 NCE (Orbitrap Exploris 480, F1/F2/F3/F8)
claims.evidence: S1 methods: Q Exactive HF-X "normalised collision energy of 28"; "For the Orbitrap Exploris 480, it was the same except ... HCD collision energy of 30".

claims.location: comment[fragment mass tolerance] all rows
claims.evidence: Deposited parameters.txt: "MS/MS tol. (FTMS) 20 ppm"; PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol: "All other settings were the software defaults". Precursor tolerance is not in parameters.txt and is omitted.

claims.location: characteristics[sample type] all rows
claims.value: negative control for the two Fyrkat blanks; study sample for the six specimens
claims.evidence: S1 describes "the two Fyrkat blanks for control of laboratory-induced deamidation".

claims.location: source name, characteristics[organism] Fyrkat rows
claims.value: one specimen "Fyrkat Grave 4 D158-1966", Mustela sp., extracted twice (urea, GuHCl); technical replicate 1 (GuHCl) and 2 (urea) keep the two analyses of the one specimen at distinct coordinates
claims.evidence: Paper: "The fur sample from Fyrkat had two different extraction methods attempted" and "The two extractions of the fur from Fyrkat suggest that it derives from the genus Mustela"; PRIDE organisms list Mustela sp.

limitations: Species identifications are results with variable taxonomic resolution; Castor canadensis is a database surrogate for archaeological Castor, so genus is used.
Age and sex of the source animals are not reported.
